summary.text: Gabriel Acevero is a Democratic member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 39 who was first elected in 2018 and has served since January 9, 2019, and he is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He serves on the Appropriations Committee, where he chairs the Public Safety and Administration Subcommittee.

paragraphs.text: Gabriel Acevero was born in Trinidad and Tobago on October 23, 1990, according to his General Assembly biography.

He earned an A.A. in international relations from Montgomery College, a B.A. in political science and public policy from the University of Maryland, Baltimore County, and a master's in public administration from Bowie State University.

He worked as a field representative for the Municipal and County Government Employees Organization and as a business development manager in commercial real estate in Baltimore, and he was a 2016 fellow of the Maryland New Leaders Council.
Acevero has served on the Appropriations Committee since 2019 and has chaired its Public Safety and Administration Subcommittee in 2026.

He is vice chair of the Maryland Legislative Latino Caucus, secretary of the Maryland Legislative LGBTQ+ Caucus, and a member of the Legislative Black Caucus of Maryland, of which he was second vice chair from 2020 to 2022.
Ballotpedia reports that he advanced from the June 23, 2026 Democratic primary.
